marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 20 knots backing to east 15 early Tuesday morning
then diminishing to light Tuesday afternoon. Snow or periods of rain changing to scattered flurries or
scattered showers this evening. Visibility 1 mile or less in
precipitation. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:

evening.<br/>
